item.title: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' Officially Fixes King Ghidorah Canon in 1 Brilliant Way
item.description: In an interview with Polygon, the film's producer, Kazuaki Kishida, wouldn't say exactly how big the budget for Godzilla Minus Zero was (though it's been confirmed to be a significantly " more " than Minus One 's $15 million), but he did reveal one way that extra money changed how Yamazaki and his team approached making the sequel.

item.title: EA Officially Brings Back 25 PC Classics With Huge Sale
item.description: Electronic Arts is not in players’ good graces right now. On Oct. 21, the publisher announced that it was closing BioWare , the beloved studio behind games like Mass Effect , Dragon Age, and Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic . The news came just a few months after EA was purchased by the Saudi Arabian government’s Public Investment Fund, Jared Kushner’s Affinity Partners, and private equity firm Silver Lake. Despite these dismal circumstances, including the fact that EA is now owned by a government responsible for numerous human rights abuses , a small group of EA developers just finished an unexpected feel-good preservation project.

item.title: New Ratchet & Clank Game Officially Cancelled by Sony
item.description: Sony 's next Ratchet & Clank game has been scrapped before receiving a full release. On Friday, Sony Interactive Entertainment and developer Oh BiBi announced Ratchet & Clank: Ranger Rumble will be pulled from storefronts this month, and fully shut down next May.

item.title: Pokémon Go Wild Area Gigantamax Machamp Timed Research and rewards
item.description: The 2026 Pokémon Go Wild Area in-person events are kicking off in Sendai, Japan and Mexico City, which means that even us global players not attending get a treat: a Gigantamax Machamp Timed Research set.

item.title: When is the next full moon for Ursaluna in Pokémon Go?
item.description: If you want Ursaluna in Pokémon Go , you'll need to evolve your Ursaring on specific evenings. Ursaring only evolves into its grizzly evolution, Ursaluna, when there's a full moon in real life ! Full moons occur once a month, so if the full moon passes, you'll need to wait another month or so to evolve it, sadly.

item.title: How to get Poké Ball Pattern Vivillon in Pokémon Legends: Z-A
item.description: Game Freak and The Pokémon Company are distributing a Poké Ball Pattern Vivillon in Pokémon Legends: Z-A , now that players have worked hard enough to unlock it. It's the first time in 10 years that pattern of Vivillon has been available, and all you need to do to get it is claim it from Mystery Gift. Scatterbug and Spewpa are comparatively easy to get early in Legends: Z-A , though this one is special.

item.title: 6 Upcoming Steam Games That Look Too Good to Ignore
item.description: As 2026 winds down, we’re now getting to the stretch of the year where developers are showcasing what games are coming next year. We recently got a glimpse of that in a Nintendo Indie World Showcase , which showed off several games coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027. If you’re a PC player who skipped over the show, you’ll be delighted to know that just about every game shown during it is also coming to Steam.

item.title: 'Godzilla Minus Zero’s Final Trailer Reveals Legendary Monster Villain
item.description: Godzilla Minus Zero is finally here. The latest installment in this larger-than-life monster series is getting a wide release in the U.S. starting today. Toho marked the occasion by sharing the film’s final trailer, which gives us a look at one of Godzilla’s greatest foes, King Ghidorah.

item.title: DMZ key and locations in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: There are loads of DMZ keys in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . Used to open both locked containers and locked doors, keys are your fast-track to getting your hands on some of the best loot the extraction mode has to offer. However, when you receive a key, you're only given a brief description of where to use it, so we're going to outline where you can use every key the game has to offer.

item.title: Keanu Reeves Officially Returning as John Wick in New Movie
item.description: Though John Wick seemingly met his end in John Wick: Chapter 4 , Keanu Reeves isn't done with his stylish assassin character just yet. A fifth John Wick live-action movie is in development, and director Chad Stahelski is also working on an animated prequel film . Now, Reeves is officially confirmed to return for it.
